evidence_snippets: Supported tasks and triggers Gemini can assist you to add the following tasks and triggers: Triggers Tasks API trigger Cloud Pub/Sub trigger Salesforce trigger Jira Cloud ServiceNow Zendesk Cloud Scheduler trigger Data mapper task Approval task Suspend task Javascript task Cloud Run functions Timer task Return task Send email task Connectors task Call REST endpoint task Doc AI - Process task Gemini also assists you to create the following control flow tasks but can't generate sub-integrations: For Each Loop task For Each Parallel task While Loop task Call Integration task Create an integration Gemini assists you to create and build integrations using your natural language statements (or prompts ) as input.
